valid_timing_error_minutes.interpretation: A nominal T-X forecast may use a qualified observation captured at or before its cutoff, never after it. Negative values are minutes early.

strict_rules: Positive timing error is later information and is invalid for the nominal T-minus forecast.
If no qualified snapshot exists by the cutoff, that game-horizon is missing for the canonical timing experiment.
A later horizon, closing price, corrected source, or postgame reconstruction may not backfill a missed cutoff.
Actual request timestamp and timing error remain part of forecast provenance.
Legacy or audit rows captured after a cutoff may remain preserved as raw evidence but are ineligible for canonical LevLine 4 horizon grading.
rationale: A forecast horizon is an information-set boundary. Symmetric timing tolerance would permit T-44 information to be labeled T-45, which violates strict point-in-time comparison even when the difference is operationally small.
